# Design: Lintel v3.7 — Frontend Design System (separat family)

**Generated by:** `/office-hours` on 2026-05-28
**Branch:** `main` (implementation öppnas på `v3.7-frontend-design-system`)
**Repo:** jokerman89/jokerman-lintel
**Status:** DRAFT_WITH_CONCERNS — väntar operator-godkännande + 7 reviewer-concerns att adressera
**Mode:** Builder (engineering scaffolding för Lintel-internal feature)
**Supersedes:** none (kompletterar [lintel-v3.5-doc-generation-plan.md](lintel-v3.5-doc-generation-plan.md))

> Production-ready frontend design e2e som familj separat från generate-* — design-director-layer vs rendering-engine-layer. Tre modes (helhet/delar/passivt). Edge är compounding-learning via design-pattern-vault, ej stack-bredd. L-trio bevarad genom tydlig separation-of-concerns med generate-* family.

---

## Problem Statement

Operatorn (CAIP-SE Solution Engineer + occasional builder) behöver kunna producera **production-ready frontend designs e2e** för:
- Customer demos och POCs som ska se Awwwards-grade ut
- Internal microsites och tools där visual quality påverkar adoption
- Multi-format engagement (när /li:cycle BUILD-phase producerar en app, design måste matcha pitch)

Existing infra i Lintel täcker ~60%:
- `skills/generate-web/` — single-file HTML eller Next.js scaffold-generation
- `skills/design-html/` — wireframe-sketches för UI-ideas
- `skills/generate-design/` — per-format layout-mappings + design_pass_hook-fält
- `skills/generate-style-learn/` — palette + font + layout-distribution extraction

Saknas:
- **Typography-curator** för variable-fonts + commercial-licensed-font-mapping (Pangram, Velvetyne, Fraunces, Recursive)
- **Motion-director** för scroll-koreografi (GSAP/ScrollTrigger), smooth-scroll (Lenis), timeline-scripting (Theatre.js), state-driven vector animation (Rive)
- **Shader-engineer** för WebGL/GLSL recommendations (OGL, Paper Shaders, react-three-fiber, lygia)
- **Full-app-scaffolder** som chainer typography + motion + shader + generate-web till production-app
- **Pattern-vault** för compounding-learning: spara/återanvänd hela design-patterns operatorn skapat
- **Passive surfacing** när operator jobbar på frontend-filer

Operator's edge-thesis: **"vi blir inte bättre än Lovable/V0/Bolt på att generera. Vi blir bättre på att återanvända vad operatorn skapat över tid."** Compounding-learning via L-001-disciplinerad pattern-vault.

## What Makes This Cool

Tre revolutionära element vs raw-tool-generation (V0/Lovable/Bolt):

1. **Design-pattern-vault-edge.** Operator extraherar hela design-patterns (typography + motion + shader + components + layout-grammar) från artifacts via `/li:frontend-style-extract`. Pattern landar i `~/.lintel/brand/design-patterns/<name>/`. Future invocations väljer från vault. Engagement N+1 är bättre design än N tack vare compounding. Detta är exact L-001 + style-learn-pattern men på pattern-level (inte palette-level).

2. **Design-director-layer vs rendering-engine-separation.** Frontend-* family äger design-decisions (typography choice, motion language, shader-thesis, component-library-pick). Existing generate-* family äger rendering (HTML, Next.js scaffold, file-output). Frontend-design-orchestrator calls `/li:generate-web --from-frontend-design <run-dir>`. Separation of concerns = clean composability + ej dubbel HTML-generation (L-002 respekterad).

3. **Three modes faller naturligt ur Lintel-pattern.**
   - **Helhet:** `/li:frontend-design "your brief"` solo, ELLER `/li:cycle --mode customer-engagement` triggers frontend-design auto i BUILD-phase om frontend-output detected.
   - **Delar:** `/li:frontend-typography`, `/li:frontend-motion`, `/li:frontend-shader` solo-invocable (Lintel-pattern).
   - **Passivt:** ny hook `hooks/frontend-design-surface.sh` surface:ar relevanta design-patterns when operator opens `.tsx`/`.css`/`*.svelte`-fil (read-only, recommendation only, ej blocker).

## Constraints

- **No commercial-asset bundling.** Pangram fonts, Velvetyne, Future Fonts = operator-licensierar separately. Lintel-skills pekar på dem som recommendations; operator installerar via Google Fonts CDN ELLER kommersiella font-services ELLER dropps assets i `~/.lintel/brand/fonts/`. Lintel ships ingen kommersiell font.
- **No bundling av runtime libraries.** GSAP, Lenis, OGL, Paper Shaders, Aceternity etc = operator installerar via npm i sitt projekt. Lintel-skills genererar code som imports them (per L-001: agent vid invocation generates the import + usage; Lintel ships skill body + agent-mapping).
- **MS-internal default tier.** Default voice_tier: internal. Customer-share kräver `/li:rais-customer-voice-check` + `/li:compliance-gate` (befintliga gates).
- **L-001 (scaffolding-not-content):** 1 canonical bundled "ultra-modern Lovable-style" design-pattern. Resten är ⚠ template only-slots tills operator extraherar via `/li:frontend-style-extract`.
- **L-001 trade-off acknowledgment** — canonical-pattern är medvetet curated content (typography.json + motion.json + shader-snippets + component-imports.json). Skäl: serverar som schema-by-example för operator-extraktioner. Utan en konkret reference vet inte extraktion-target hur en pattern.json ska se ut. **Re-evaluate efter Fas D dogfood** — om operator-extracted patterns dominerar vault (>3 patterns), kan canonical demotas till sample-fil i docs/.
- **L-002 (grep-first):** generate-web + design-html + generate-style-learn + brand-asset-pattern bevaras. Frontend-* family separation = identity, NOT replacement. Boundary explicitly documented.
- **L-003 (verify-claims):** stack-recommendations i SKILL.md verifies at runtime via current docs (Recursive font GA-status, GSAP licensing-version, Paper-shaders MIT-confirmation). Don't hardcode claims.

## Premises (locked per office-hours D1 + 4 premise-challenges)

1. **Operator-stack-rekommendationer = generation-targets, ej bundles.** Pangram/GSAP/OGL/Aceternity är vad agent genererar code INTO. Operator installerar/licensierar. Lintel ships scaffolding only (L-001).

2. **Save-pattern-edge = brand-template-pattern på design-pattern-level.** `~/.lintel/brand/design-patterns/<name>/` blir ny slot-folder. 1 canonical pattern bundled, rest är slots.

3. **Three modes mappar till befintliga Lintel-patterns.** Helhet = orchestrator. Delar = solo-invocable sub-skills. Passivt = hook. Ingen ny arkitektur krävs.

4. **Edge är compounding, ej stack-bredd.** Vi blir bättre på återanvändning av operatorns work över tid via L-trio + pattern-vault. Vi blir inte bättre på att GENERERA design än Lovable/V0.

5. **D1 (operator-choice): B = separat frontend-* family.** Despite my recommended A (extend generate-*), operator valde B för **identity + clean namespace-separation**. Validating reasoning: "frontend" som namespace-anchor är starkare än "another generate sub-skill." Accepterad. Separation-of-concerns med generate-* görs via explicit boundary (design-director vs rendering-engine).

## Cross-Model Perspective

Phase 3.5 skipped per operator velocity-pattern (consistent med tidigare design-docs i denna session). Premiss-challenges hanterades direkt i office-hours-session.

## Approaches Considered (Phase 4)

### Approach A: Extend `generate-*` family (rejected)
- Add 5 new sub-skills + agent-family + brand-asset-slot till existing generate-* family.
- **Rejected because:** Operator preferred clean namespace-separation. "Frontend" som identity-anchor är starkare än "another generate sub-skill."

### Approach B: New `frontend-*` family (CHOSEN per D1)
- Separat family med tydlig design-director-vs-rendering-engine-separation från generate-*.
- Details below.

### Approach C: Atomic foundation-skills + meta-orchestrator (rejected)
- skills/typography, skills/motion, skills/shader som standalones + meta-orchestrator.
- **Rejected because:** Atomic skills tappar context-of-use; meta-orchestrator-complexity-risk.

## Recommended Approach — Frontend-* family with explicit separation

### Skill family layout

```
skills/
├── frontend-design/                # Orchestrator (helhet-mode)
│   └── SKILL.md
├── frontend-typography/            # Sub-skill: font + variable-axes-selection
│   └── SKILL.md
├── frontend-motion/                # Sub-skill: GSAP/Lenis/Theatre/Rive spec
│   └── SKILL.md
├── frontend-shader/                # Sub-skill: OGL/Paper-shaders/r3f
│   └── SKILL.md
├── frontend-app-scaffold/          # Format-builder: full app scaffolding (chainer generate-web)
│   └── SKILL.md
├── frontend-style-extract/         # Sister till generate-style-learn (pattern-level extraction)
│   └── SKILL.md
└── frontend-design-review/         # Quality gate för produced frontend designs
    └── SKILL.md
```

Total: 7 nya skills. Ingen overlap med generate-* — explicit boundary nedan.

### New agent family

```
agents/frontend/
├── FrontendArchitect.md            # Primary för frontend-design orchestrator
├── MotionDirector.md               # Motion-language curator
├── TypographyCurator.md            # Font + variable-axes-specialist
├── ShaderEngineer.md               # WebGL/GLSL specialist
└── DesignSystemAuditor.md          # Design-review quality gate
```

Total: 5 nya agents i ny `frontend/` category.

### New brand-asset-slots

```
~/.lintel/brand/
├── design-patterns/                # NEW: saved reusable design patterns
│   ├── ultra-modern-lovable-style/ # 1 canonical bundled pattern (this PR ships it)
│   │   ├── pattern.json
│   │   ├── typography.json
│   │   ├── motion.json
│   │   ├── shader-snippets/
│   │   └── component-imports.json
│   └── README.md
├── motion-libraries/               # NEW: GSAP/Lenis/etc operator-tested combos
│   └── README.md
├── shader-snippets/                # NEW: operator-curated GLSL snippets
│   └── README.md
└── (existing folders preserved)
```

Plus 1 canonical bundled design-pattern: `ultra-modern-lovable-style/` (hand-curated baseline. Operator extends via `/li:frontend-style-extract`).

### New hooks

```
hooks/
├── frontend-design-surface.sh      # NEW: passive-mode hook
└── (existing hooks preserved)
```

Hook fires när operator opens `.tsx`/`.jsx`/`.svelte`/`.vue`/`.css`/`.scss`-fil. Surface 1-line: "Design patterns relevant: X, Y. /li:frontend-design --pattern <name>." Read-only, no blocker.

### Explicit boundary med generate-* family (avoid L-002-violation)

| Concern | Frontend-* family | Generate-* family |
|---|---|---|
| **Layer** | Design-director (decisions) | Rendering-engine (file-output) |
| **Typography choice** | ✅ frontend-typography | ❌ |
| **Motion language** | ✅ frontend-motion | ❌ |
| **Shader thesis** | ✅ frontend-shader | ❌ |
| **Component-library-pick** | ✅ frontend-design | ❌ |
| **HTML/Next.js file-gen** | ❌ | ✅ generate-web |
| **PPT/DOCX rendering** | ❌ | ✅ generate-ppt/word |
| **Palette extraction** | ❌ | ✅ generate-style-learn |
| **Pattern-level extraction** | ✅ frontend-style-extract | ❌ |

**Frontend-design orchestrator workflow:**

```
/li:frontend-design "<brief>"
  │
  ├─ Step 1: SENSE-light (read operator-prompt + warm relevant patterns)
  ├─ Step 2: frontend-typography → choose fonts + variable-axes
  ├─ Step 3: frontend-motion → motion-language-spec
  ├─ Step 4: frontend-shader → shader-thesis (om hero-visual behövs)
  ├─ Step 5: frontend-design synthesizes → design-spec.json
  ├─ Step 6: CALL generate-web --from-frontend-design <run-dir>
  │         (rendering-engine produces single-file HTML eller Next.js scaffold)
  ├─ Step 7: frontend-design-review → quality gate
  └─ Step 8: Output paths + recommendation
```

Generate-web gets a new `--from-frontend-design <run-dir>` mode (parallel till `--from-pipeline` från Fas 2) that reads frontend-design's design-spec.json + applies WebExperienceCritic per existing pattern.

### Per-skill spec summary

**`/li:frontend-design`** (orchestrator, helhet-mode):
- Input: `<brief>` + optional `--pattern <vault-name>` + optional `--target-format <single-file|nextjs|app>`
- Chainer typography → motion → shader (om relevant) → synthesizes design-spec.json
- Calls `/li:generate-web --from-frontend-design <run-dir>` för rendering
- Calls `/li:frontend-design-review` för quality gate
- Output: `~/.lintel/frontend-runs/<run-id>/` med artifacts
- Voice tier: internal default, customer-share triggers `/li:compliance-gate`

**`/li:frontend-typography`** (sub-skill, delar-mode):
- Input: `--brief <text>` ELLER `--target-audience <description>` + optional `--mood <serif-display|tight-mono|variable-experimental>`
- TypographyCurator agent picks från font-recommendation-tree (Google Fonts | Pangram | Velvetyne | Recursive | Fraunces | Future Fonts) with licensing-context
- Output: `typography.json` med font-family-stacks + variable-axes-config + size-scale + line-heights + font-loading-strategy
- Includes operator-instruction: "to use Pangram, license at pangrampangram.com + install via brand-update"

**`/li:frontend-motion`** (sub-skill, delar-mode):
- Input: `--brief <text>` + optional `--energy-level <subtle|moderate|kinetic>`
- MotionDirector agent picks motion-language (GSAP-scroll-koreografi | Lenis-smooth | Theatre-timeline | Rive-state | Motion-One-light)
- Output: `motion.json` med library-recommendations + scroll-trigger-config + smooth-scroll-config + key-animations-spec
- Includes operator-instruction: "npm install gsap @studio-freight/lenis ..."

**`/li:frontend-shader`** (sub-skill, delar-mode):
- Input: `--brief <text>` + optional `--visual-thesis <mesh-gradient|noise-field|fluid-sim|particle-system>`
- ShaderEngineer agent picks (Paper Shaders deklarativt | OGL+glslify | react-three-fiber+postprocessing | Lygia-snippets)
- Output: `shader.json` med library-pick + glsl-snippet-references + perf-budget
- Includes operator-instruction + GPU-fallback-strategy

**`/li:frontend-app-scaffold`** (format-builder):
- Input: `--brief <text>` + `--from-frontend-design <run-dir>` + optional `--stack <next-app|vite-react|svelte-kit>`
- Full app-scaffold orchestrator: chains design-spec + generates project skeleton + wires up motion/shader/typography
- Output: Working repo skeleton operator can `npm install && npm run dev`
- Voice + compliance-gate per customer-share

**`/li:frontend-style-extract`** (pattern-level extraction, sister till generate-style-learn):
- Input: `<files>` (1+ artifacts: live URLs, screenshots, Figma exports, existing .tsx files)
- Extract pattern-level: not just colors+fonts (that's style-learn), but **layout grammar**, **motion language**, **interaction patterns**, **component-library-fingerprint**, **shader-thesis**
- Output: `~/.lintel/brand/design-patterns/<name>/` med pattern.json + typography.json + motion.json + shader-snippets + component-imports.json
- Pairs naturally med generate-style-learn (palette+fonts) + frontend-style-extract (pattern) = full design-DNA

**`/li:frontend-design-review`** (quality gate):
- Input: produced artifact (HTML, Next.js project, screenshots)
- DesignSystemAuditor agent runs 6-dimension audit: typography hierarchy + motion coherence + shader perf-budget + accessibility WCAG AA + brand conformance + responsive-fidelity
- Output: `design-review.json` med green/yellow/red verdict
- Pairas med `/li:compliance-gate` för customer-share runs

### Canonical bundled pattern: `ultra-modern-lovable-style`

Ships i `~/.lintel/brand/design-patterns/ultra-modern-lovable-style/` som L-001 canonical example:
- **typography.json**: Pangram-style stack (operator licenserar; fallback till free variant), variable-axes specified
- **motion.json**: GSAP-ScrollTrigger för act-koreografi, Lenis-smooth-scroll, fade-in-up patterns
- **shader-snippets/**: 1 Paper-Shaders mesh-gradient som hero-bakgrund
- **component-imports.json**: shadcn + Aceternity + Magic UI + Vaul + cmdk-references
- **pattern.json**: synthesizes ovan + visual thesis + content plan + interaction signature

Operator extraherar nya patterns via `/li:frontend-style-extract` → vault expanderar över tid.

## Open Questions

1. **Operator-instruction-format för font-licensing.** När frontend-typography recommends Pangram, output ska inkludera step-by-step license-instruction. Markdown-section i typography.json? Separate `LICENSING.md`?
2. **Pattern-vault collision-handling.** Om operator extract:ar 2 patterns med samma name → confirm via AskUserQuestion (`--overwrite`-flag pattern from style-learn applies).
3. **Performance-budget för WebGL/Shaders.** Skall frontend-shader hård-blocka om GPU-perf-budget överskrids på low-end devices? Recommendation: warn-only initially, hard-block when operator opts-in via flag.
4. **Hook firing-noise.** Passive-frontend-design-surface kan bli annoying om triggar varje .tsx open. Throttle: max 1 surface per file per session. Operator-disable via `/li:profile-switch --dormant frontend-design-surface`.

## Success Criteria

- Operator invokerar `/li:frontend-design "Azure Arc for Nordic Public Sector landing page"` och får färdig single-file HTML eller Next.js scaffold med Lovable-grade design quality **inom 10 minuter för simple briefs** (5 sub-skill-chain × 30-60s + generate-web + design-review). Complex briefs (multi-page apps) kan ta upp till 20 min.
- Solo `/li:frontend-typography "ai-app for legal professionals"` returns typography.json med 2-3 font-stack-options + variable-axes + licensing-instruction inom 60s.
- Hook fires när operator opens `.tsx` och surface:ar 1 relevant pattern från vault (eller silent om no match) inom 200ms.
- Operator extraherar pattern från live URL via `/li:frontend-style-extract https://customer-A.com` och pattern landar i vault, kan re-användas i nästa invocation.
- Frontend-design-review fångar 3-5 quality issues per produced artifact (typography hierarchy break, motion-thrash, accessibility-gap, etc).
- Hand-bundled `ultra-modern-lovable-style`-pattern produces verifiably high-quality output på en standard "AI app landing page"-brief.

## Distribution Plan

Standard Lintel install-pipeline. Frontend-* family ships som del av `install/install.sh` + `install/install.ps1`. Brand-asset-slots bootstrappas (folders + READMEs) på install. Canonical `ultra-modern-lovable-style`-pattern bundled.

Operator-side dependencies (npm packages: gsap, lenis, ogl, paper-design, three, etc) installeras av operator i sina projekt — Lintel ships ingen package.

## Dependencies

- **Existing generate-web** — modifies för `--from-frontend-design <dir>` mode (parallel till `--from-pipeline` från Fas 2). Non-breaking.
- **Existing generate-style-learn** — sibling-relationship med frontend-style-extract. Document boundary i båda skill bodies.
- **Existing compliance-gate** — frontend-design orchestrator calls för customer-share.
- **Existing TrailblazerVoiceCritic** / `/li:rais-customer-voice-check` — voice-gate.
- **Existing `~/.lintel/brand/`-pattern** — new sub-folders följer existing convention.
- **operator-side npm-packages** — gsap, lenis, ogl, paper-design, three, @react-three/fiber, etc. Lintel-skill outputs operator-instruction.

## Implementation Phases

**Fas A: Foundation (1 PR, ~4-5 dagar CC)** — bumped från 3-4 per reviewer-concern Feasibility #2
- 7 new SKILL.md files (frontend-design + 6 sub-skills) — ~1.5 dagar
- 5 new agent .md files i `agents/frontend/` — ~0.5 dag
- New `agents/frontend/`-folder added till `tests/unit/agents-categorized.sh`
- Schema-spec inline i SKILL.md för design-spec.json + pattern.json + typography.json (load-bearing kontrakt för Fas B) — ~0.5 dag
- Brand-asset-slot bootstrapping i install scripts — ~0.5 dag
- Canonical `ultra-modern-lovable-style`-pattern bundled — ~1 dag hand-curation
- Test: `tests/unit/frontend-skills-present.sh` — ~0.5 dag

**Mini-fas A2 (optional split om Fas A blir för stor):** canonical-pattern hand-curation ships separat PR efter foundation merge.

**Fas B: Generate-web integration (1 PR, ~1-2 dagar CC)**
- generate-web SKILL.md updated med `--from-frontend-design <dir>` mode
- Boundary-docs i both family-skills explaining design-director vs rendering-engine
- Test: integration test covering frontend-design → generate-web roundtrip

**Fas C: Passive hook + pattern-vault (1 PR, ~1 dag CC)**
- `hooks/frontend-design-surface.sh` med throttle-logic
- Hook install + hooks.jsonl integration
- `/li:frontend-style-extract` ships first canonical extraction-flow
- Test: hook-firing test

**Fas D: Real-app dogfood (operator-only)**
- Operator picks real engagement, runs `/li:frontend-design` end-to-end
- Capture insights → L-004 if durable pattern emerges
- Extract first non-canonical pattern via `/li:frontend-style-extract` → validates vault loop

## Reviewer Concerns

Adversarial review (ReadOnly subagent, 5 dimensions) gav **7/10 approve-with-revisions**. 4 MAJOR-fixes applicerade inline (5min→10min, Fas A 3-4d→4-5d, L-001 trade-off-acknowledgment, schema-spec i Fas A scope). Återstående concerns nedan — adresseras vid Fas A implementation eller följdiget design-iteration.

### MAJOR — adressera FÖRE Fas A PR öppnas

1. **`design-spec.json` schema måste specas inline i frontend-design SKILL.md.** Load-bearing kontrakt för Fas B (generate-web's `--from-frontend-design` mode). Utan schema kan Fas B inte kodas. **Fix:** add abbreviated JSON schema (5-10 fields) som inline-spec i frontend-design SKILL.md Workflow Step 5 vid implementation-time.

2. **`pattern.json` + `typography.json` schemas saknas.** Implementer kan inte bygga canonical-pattern utan kontrakt. **Fix:** add inline schemas i frontend-style-extract SKILL.md (it owns the extraction-target).

3. **`frontend-design-review` 6-dimension audit har ingen scoring rubric.** "Green/yellow/red verdict" på vad? **Fix:** add scoring matrix per dimension (≥80=green, 60-79=yellow, <60=red) ELLER defer review-skill till Fas C när vault-content finns att kalibrera mot.

### MAJOR — adressera vid Fas B implementation

4. **Helhet-mode `--mode customer-engagement` auto-trigger** för cycle-integration är hand-waved ("triggers frontend-design auto i BUILD-phase om frontend-output detected"). Vad detekterar frontend-output? **Fix:** defer cycle-integration till Fas D explicit ELLER spec detection-hook (`hooks/detect-frontend-output.sh`) i Fas C scope.

### MINOR — adressera vid implementation eller skip

Du värderar "frontend som identity" mer än "minimum-skill-family-count". Det är coherent med tidigare session-mönster där du valde V2 (cycle-shaped) över V1 (DECKFORGE-port) i forge-design — du gillar starka identity-anchors.
- "Vår edge kanske blir att vi kan spara design-patterns vi tar fram och återanvända dem" — du ser direkt att Lovable/V0 inte kan beat:as på generation, men kan beat:as på compounding. Det är samma instinkt som L-001 + L-002 + L-003 trion. Edge är discipline, ej toolchain.
- "dlx/deeplex var ett testprojekt, får inte benämnas eller återberättas igen" — du sätter hard guard för project-specific references. Den disciplinen translatar till hur design-docs ska struktureras: scaffolding-and-pattern, ej project-specific-content. L-001 i action.
- "Mappa in i Lintel with pride :D" — du värderar känslan att Lintel **äger** featuren, inte att Lintel **inkorporerar** något.
